title: GPU-Initiated Discrete Simulated Bifurcation: Low-Latency Requests and Streaming Dense Couplings
summary: GPU-based optimization faces two communication bottlenecks: coordinating frequent requests and delivering dense models that exceed device memory. We present a discrete simulated bifurcation (dSB) architecture that addresses both through NVIDIA DOCA GPUNetIO. For resident models, a persistent service receives field updates, executes each solve within one GPU thread block, and returns the result.
